name: Complete Linear task from Todoist
description: When I complete a mirrored Todoist task, mark the linked Linear issue as done.

triggers.description: Runs when a Todoist task mirrored from Linear is completed

steps.title: Extract Linear reference
steps.description: Reads the Linear issue identifier from the link the mirror puts on the first line of the task description.

steps.title: Complete Linear issue
steps.description: Marks the Linear issue Done, unless it is already closed.
steps.prompt:
Mark the Linear issue `` steps.extractLinearRef.linearRef `` as Done.

1. Call mcp.linear['get_issue'] with id `` steps.extractLinearRef.linearRef ``. If the call fails or returns no issue, change nothing and return outcome "notFound".
2. If the issue's statusType is "completed", "canceled" or "duplicate", change nothing and return outcome "alreadyClosed".
3. Otherwise call mcp.linear['save_issue'] with id `` steps.extractLinearRef.linearRef `` and state "Done", and no other fields. Return outcome "completed".

Return issueIdentifier `` steps.extractLinearRef.linearRef `` and the outcome.

steps.title: Summarize result
steps.description: Builds a short summary of the completed Linear issue.
